name: Milk Flower
subtitle: Hanoi Autumn Scent
mechanism: Aura (AuraPlant). Every pulse_interval s, every grounded enemy within aura_radius is slowed to slow_mult for slow_duration s (HungryGhost.apply_slow, which multiplies with speed buffs, so an Aerobics Auntie's x1.3 becomes x0.65) and takes damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Scent
abilities.trigger: Every 1 s while enemies are near
abilities.effect: Enemies within 4.5 m walk at x0.5 for 1.2 s and take 4 damage.

clipAnnotations.attack: Tree inhales, clusters swell to puff out the scent.
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the lawn.
